answer: Written in a user experience perspective, adoption barriers register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the ripple until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vine of the next round. Reaching the grove of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on time-locked escrow with arbitration fallback.
